Class SampleVirtual

Namespace: osu.Framework.Audio.Sample
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A osu.Framework.Audio.Sample.Sample which explicitly plays no audio. Aimed for scenarios in which a non-null osu.Framework.Audio.Sample.Sample is needed, but one that doesn't necessarily play any sound.

public sealed class SampleVirtual : Sample, IDisposable, IUpdateable, ISample, IAdjustableAudioComponent, IAggregateAudioAdjustment
